title: False-positive pattern: verbose error page discloses stack trace without authentication
content: Detector 'verbose error page discloses stack trace without authentication' has produced false positives on example.com. A lone verbose error page does NOT establish information disclosure. Before acting, require a confirmed sensitive value in the trace (credentials, keys, absolute paths exposing internals) AND reproduce the response without authentication. Prefer technique: IDOR object identifier comparison across accounts.
